blocks.text: Langley: how mobile and manufactured homes work here

items.t: How ownership works in a park: many residents own their manufactured home and rent the site it sits on under a Manufactured Home Site Tenancy Agreement, under BC's Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act. Where both the home and the site are rented, a Residential Tenancy Agreement applies instead.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect park-home buyers

items.t: Zoning in the two Langleys: parks in the Township are under Township Zoning Bylaw No. 2500, and properties in the City of Langley are under City Zoning Bylaw No. 3300. Small-scale multi-unit housing rules don't apply to pad rentals.

A sale doesn't reset the pad rent: when the tenancy is assigned, the current pad rent and the date of the next increase pass to the buyer. The rent history is in the tenancy agreement, which the seller must share before asking the park for consent.

faq.q: Do I own the land under a park home in this price band?
faq.a: No, in a pad-rental park. You own the home (a chattel) and rent the pad — the park owns the land, and your right to the site is the assigned pad tenancy under the MHPTA. Pioneer Park is the exception in form, not in land ownership: there you buy the home plus co-op shares, not land.

faq.q: Does the park raise my pad rent when I buy the home?
faq.a: No. When the pad tenancy is assigned, the pad rent stays the same and the date of the next increase doesn't change. The landlord must consent in writing first (or be deemed to consent, or be ordered to), and can't charge a fee for it.

faq.q: Can a park refuse me because of age?
faq.a: In a 55+ park, yes on assignment: the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Regulation recognises a park where every site is reserved for a tenant who has reached 55 and allows the landlord to refuse an assignment where the proposed purchaser does not meet the park's age requirement. The strata exemptions do not automatically apply — ask the park for its rule in writing.

faq.q: What is the monthly cost stack besides the purchase price?
faq.a: Besides the price: pad rent (set by each park and capped each year by the provincial formula), home insurance, property tax on the home (in a park, the land isn't included), and utilities as the park's agreement splits them. Ask the park for the current pad rent on the exact site; it varies by park.

faq.q: Are there market statistics for Langley mobile homes under $500k?
faq.a: No manufactured-home statistics are published in the SnapStats report — it has no manufactured-home category. The only SnapStats figures for Langley are all-residential community context, as of September 2026: Detached median $1,345,000 (449 active, 64 sold) and Condos & Townhomes median $611,000 (699 active, 128 sold).
